name: Kenton Rees
summary: A treasure hunter who runs the Island Dreams shop in Key Lento and sends the player diving on shipwrecks.
body: PowerPyx calls Kenton a treasure hunter with an Island Dreams shop by the beach and says his jobs are marked by a green KR icon in Key Lento.
PowerPyx says he offers seven shipwreck treasure sets found with an underwater metal detector, is away for a while after Chapter 1, and stays available after the story.
GTA Wiki lists him as Trinidadian, a close friend of Brian Heder, and owner of a boat called the Sea Enchantress; it gives no voice actor.

name: Donnie
summary: A seaplane pilot tied to Brian Heder's operation who also buys stolen goods in south Key Lento during Chapter 1.
body: PowerPyx lists Donnie as a Chapter 1 fence in south Key Lento who pays low prices for narcotics and very low prices for jewelry and marked bills.
PowerPyx's walkthrough has him meeting the player at a seaplane in Southwind, and a mission title places his home in a trailer.
GTA Wiki says he appears to work as a pilot for Brian's Boat Works & Marina and links him to Brian Heder and Cal Hampton; it gives no voice actor.

name: Shirley
summary: Jason's neighbour in Key Lento who hands out two small Chapter 1 errands.
body: PowerPyx describes Shirley as Jason's neighbour in Key Lento, Mariana County, who asks him to fetch rum from Three Sheets Liquor.
PowerPyx says her two errands exist only in Chapter 1, can be missed, and do not count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy.

name: Kirk
summary: A man who hunts a bigfoot-like creature he calls the Skunk Ape or Mr. Mangrove in the Mariana County swamps.
body: PowerPyx says Kirk searches at night with a drone near Pelican River and that the player reaches him by reading one of his flyers at Skeeter's bar in Hamlet and phoning him.
PowerPyx counts his three missions toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy; they are night-only and one is for Lucia only.

name: Arnold
summary: Brian Heder's long-time broker, found in the Key Lento area.
body: PowerPyx describes Arnold as Brian's long-time broker and places him by a small building in Key Lento during the Chapter 1 mission Hey Arnold!.

name: Mandy
summary: A Key Lento resident who rents one of Brian Heder's properties.
body: GTA Wiki says Mandy lives on Peach Palm Drive in Key Lento and rents a property from Brian Heder.
PowerPyx's walkthrough has a Chapter 1 mission about collecting her rent.

name: Mattia
summary: A friend of Jason and Lucia who offers them a job said to lead to better-paid work.
body: PowerPyx says Mattia and Kat hang out with Jason and Lucia, starting from the Rusty Anchor bar in Key Lento, and that Mattia has a henchman called Burim.
PowerPyx does not state his occupation.

facts.affiliation: Kat; Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos (friends)

name: Kat
summary: A friend of Jason and Lucia who appears alongside Mattia.
body: PowerPyx names Kat with Mattia in the Chapter 1 mission Day Release.
GTA Wiki lists her as a supporting character and friend of both leads, first shown in the second trailer; it gives no occupation or voice actor.

facts.affiliation: Mattia; Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos (friends)

name: Burim
summary: A henchman who works for Mattia.
body: PowerPyx identifies Burim only as Mattia's henchman.

name: Linda
summary: The manager at the front desk of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
body: PowerPyx says Linda works the front desk of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, where the player pays for a room.

name: Vicki
summary: A dancer at the Delights strip club in Port Gellhorn who lives at the Starlet Motel and points the player to local contacts.
body: PowerPyx says Vicki works at Delights, lives in Room 10 of the Starlet Motel, and gives Chapter 2 missions.
PowerPyx says she is the one who refers the player to the mechanic Moses and that Dunk is her local dealer.

name: Frankie Delight
summary: Owner of the Delights strip club and Vicki's boss.
body: PowerPyx names Frankie Delight as the owner of the Delights strip club, where Vicki works.

name: Dunk
summary: A Port Gellhorn drug dealer who becomes a fence and marks robbery targets on the map.
body: PowerPyx says Dunk lives in a trailer in Port Gellhorn, sells drugs at the town car wash, and is supplied by a man known as Doctor Bill.
PowerPyx lists him as a fence unlocked by the Chapter 2 mission Slam Dunk, paying low prices for narcotics and jewelry and very low prices for marked bills.
PowerPyx says he later phones with robbery tips that mark two locations on the map.

facts.home: Trailer in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County

name: Doctor Bill
summary: A retired doctor, nicknamed Doctor Bill with the Pill, who has been Dunk's pill supplier.
body: PowerPyx says Doctor Bill has retired and no longer has access to prescriptions, and that he dealt with the Kolts gang through a dealer named Declan.

name: Declan
summary: A pill dealer inside the Kolts gang.
body: PowerPyx identifies Declan as Doctor Bill's pill dealer within the Kolts gang.

name: Moses
summary: A Port Gellhorn mechanic who registers stolen vehicles as personal cars and buys cars that have no tracker.
body: PowerPyx says Moses runs an auto shop in Port Gellhorn, is unlocked by a Chapter 2 mission, stays available after the story, and also sends requests for specific vehicles.
PowerPyx says cars must be scanned with the Waink app first because he only takes those without a tracker.
GTA Wiki has a page for an unnamed fence and mechanic at Watkins Auto Parts in Port Gellhorn seen in the Extended Look video; it does not name him, so whether this is Moses is unconfirmed.
role: Mechanic and car fence, Port Gellhorn

name: Kyle
summary: A farmer at McKittrick Farm in Kelly County who needs help flying his crop duster and fetching chemicals.
body: PowerPyx says Kyle hands out flyers, one of them outside the Starlet Motel reception, and that his farm's airstrip lies just east of the motel.
PowerPyx says his three missions count toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy and that he grows strawberries with his own chemical spray.
GTA Wiki's Kyle page instead describes a minor character who is a friend of Dobbs and Jeremy on a bachelor party at Island Dreams; the two pages disagree or describe two different people.

name: Bret Vogel
summary: Jason's old army friend who runs the Killtelligence hunting business near Mount Kalaga and pays for hunted animals.
body: PowerPyx says Bret texts only Jason during Chapter 2 and that his questline starts in the far north of Lummox County.
PowerPyx says he hands over a unique Killtelligence SM-69 hunting rifle, marks hunting spots on the map, and pays more for cleanly killed animals.
PowerPyx notes his contact entry appears under Progress > Contacts once met.

name: Billy
summary: Leader of a dirt bike crew based around the Thrillbilly Mud Club in Kelly County who brings the player along on jobs.
body: PowerPyx says Billy's five-mission strand starts with a race at the Thrillbilly Mud Club and continues with jobs he phones in.
PowerPyx lists Wyman, Ricardo "Ricky" and Brittney as members of his crew.

name: Wyman
summary: A member of Billy's dirt bike crew who tells Jason and Lucia about the Mud Club races.
body: PowerPyx says Wyman turns up at the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, recommends the Mud Club races, and rides with Billy's crew.

name: Ricardo "Ricky"
summary: A rider in Billy's dirt bike crew.
body: PowerPyx lists Ricardo, known as Ricky, among the members of Billy's dirt bike crew.

name: Brittney
summary: A rider in Billy's dirt bike crew.
body: PowerPyx lists Brittney among the members of Billy's dirt bike crew.

name: Yago
summary: A Vice City street racer whose four-mission strand begins at a race in Salton.
body: PowerPyx says Yago is met at a Hit 'n' Run VC race in Salton after a text from Manuel, and that he then offers three more missions, two of them for Jason only.
PowerPyx counts his strand toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy.

name: Manuel
summary: A contact of Dre'Quan who adds the player to a group chat and invites them to street races.
body: PowerPyx says Manuel texts the player about the Salton street race a few minutes after the Chapter 3 mission Dealer's Choice.

name: Andy
summary: A woman who has joined the vape-selling group Cellerica and tries to recruit Lucia from her home in Belville.
body: PowerPyx says Andy phones Lucia in Chapter 3 and texts a new home address in Belville, Leonard County; her five missions are for Lucia only.
PowerPyx says her house came from Cellerica and that her mentor in the group is called Bailey.

name: Bailey
summary: Andy's mentor, or "pillar", inside Cellerica.
body: PowerPyx says new Cellerica members get a mentor called a pillar and names Bailey as Andy's.

name: Yasmani
summary: A Little Cuba store owner who fences goods at the best jewelry prices and commissions robberies.
body: PowerPyx lists Yasmani as a fence in Little Cuba, Vice City, paying high prices for jewelry and marked bills and medium prices for narcotics, and available after the story.
PowerPyx says he asks for specific pieces from jewelry stores, then offers ATM and payday loan jobs, and gives the player a Snap Gun.
PowerPyx says that after two payday loan robberies he sells armored van route tips for $10,000, and that goods can be dropped at the player's garage with him chosen as buyer.

name: Randy
summary: A Vice City car fence with a showroom who pays well for a wish list of high-end cars.
body: PowerPyx places Randy in Balsero, Vice City, marks him with a green RK icon, and says his wish list has 16 sports cars whose locations he reveals one at a time.
PowerPyx says he takes high-end cars with advanced trackers, pays roughly $35,000 or more for one in perfect condition, and stays available after the story.
GTA Wiki also describes him as a car fence who asks Jason or Lucia to bring him vehicles.

name: Tyrone
summary: A La Perle contact who pays the best prices for narcotics and has Jason go after Kitty Litter drug labs.
body: PowerPyx lists Tyrone as a fence in La Perle, Vice City, paying high prices for narcotics and medium prices for jewelry and marked bills, available after the story.
PowerPyx says he is found at an apartment complex in La Perle and that his lab missions are for Jason only.
GTA Wiki says he appears to be an acquaintance of Dre'Quan Priest and to share a La Perle residence with several people; it gives no voice actor.

name: Eddie Acosta
summary: A crypto enthusiast met at a bar who invites the player to a party in Heathcliff Heights.
body: PowerPyx says Eddie texts the invitation a few days after the Chapter 4 mission Pool Day and that it can only be taken up while playing solo.

name: Pilot Pete
summary: A pilot who flies drug drops and hires Jason for paid air delivery jobs out of Sundown Private Airfield.
body: PowerPyx says Pete phones Jason early in Chapter 4, that the work starts at Sundown Private Airfield in Leonard County, and that his strand is for Jason only.
PowerPyx gives his pay as $12,000 for the first job and $20,000 for later deliveries, and counts the strand toward the Strangers & Freaks trophy.

name: Mia Caminos
summary: Lucia's mother, who has just opened her own real estate business.
body: PowerPyx says Mia gives Lucia-only missions in Chapter 3, one of them titled South Leonida Real Estate.

name: Lorena
summary: A person the player sends money to in two Chapter 3 objectives.
body: PowerPyx's walkthrough lists the objectives Send Money to Lorena and Send More Money to Lorena and says nothing more about who she is.

name: Felipe
summary: The driver in Raul Bautista's robbery crew.
body: PowerPyx says Felipe keeps a prepared vehicle outside the crew's planning room in Stockyard.

name: Karim
summary: The tech expert in Raul Bautista's crew, who cuts alarms and marks the next bank to rob.
body: PowerPyx describes Karim's role in the crew and has Jason meet him at a boatyard in La Perle.

name: Andrea
summary: The member of Raul Bautista's crew who handles comms and disguises and offers the player mask sets.
body: PowerPyx says Andrea is found upstairs in the crew's planning room in Stockyard and gives missions to both Lucia and Jason.

name: Monty
summary: A senior enforcer for the La Polilla Negra cartel.
body: PowerPyx describes Monty as a high-up La Polilla Negra enforcer encountered at a cockfight in Watson Bay.

name: Nicole Park
summary: A security expert for Sinfrontera National Bank who is guarded by La Polilla Negra.
body: PowerPyx names Nicole Park as the bank's security expert and says she has a La Polilla Negra protection detail.

name: Abe Gonzalez
summary: A man the player meets in the Chapter 4 mission Lawyer Up and then pays fees to.
body: PowerPyx's walkthrough introduces him in a mission titled Lawyer Up (Meet Abe Gonzalez) and lists Pay Abe's Fee objectives in Chapters 4 and 5; it gives no other detail.

name: Nate
summary: A contact Lucia calls and spends time with during the Chapter 4 airport job preparations.
body: PowerPyx's walkthrough lists Call Nate and Cash Injections (Hang Out With Nate) as Lucia-only missions and gives no description of him.

name: Kordell
summary: Head of a crew the player helps during Chapter 4.
body: PowerPyx's walkthrough lists Team Building (Meet Kordell), a Lucia-only mission, and two missions about helping Kordell's crew; it gives no description of him.

name: Valentina
summary: An associate of Andrés de León and Megamundo's corporate staff, also seen in GTA Online.
body: GTA Wiki says Valentina is called Val by Lucia, appears to be a client of Mr. Faber, and first appeared in GTA Online's Money Fronts update; it cites the Extended Look video for her GTA VI role and gives no voice actor.
PowerPyx's walkthrough names her only in a Chapter 4 objective, Call Valentina Back.

facts.affiliation: Andrés de León; Petra Navarro; Mr. Faber

name: Andrés de León
summary: A man connected to Megamundo's corporate staff for whom Jason works security.
body: GTA Wiki says Andrés appears to be in the entertainment business and knows Valentina and Megamundo's Petra Navarro, citing the Extended Look video; it gives no voice actor.
PowerPyx's walkthrough lists a Jason-only Chapter 4 mission about working security for him.

name: Rafa
summary: A character named in two Chapter 4 mission titles.
body: PowerPyx's walkthrough names Rafa only in mission titles and does not say who he is.

name: Méndez
summary: A Vice City Police Department officer.
body: GTA Wiki identifies him as a VCPD officer by his badge and cites the second trailer, the Extended Look video and the launch trailer; it gives no rank or voice actor.
PowerPyx's walkthrough refers to him as Captain Méndez.

name: Evelyn Andrews
summary: Owner of Evelyn Andrews Antiques in Capri.
body: PowerPyx names her as the store's owner and a colleague of the antiques appraiser Benedict Halifax.

name: Benedict Halifax
summary: A British antiques dealer who appraises items and is linked to the Capri antique store.
body: PowerPyx describes Halifax as a British antiquer and a colleague of Evelyn Andrews.

name: Dobbs
summary: One of three bachelor party guests who join Kenton's dive trip from Island Dreams.
body: PowerPyx names Dobbs as one of the three bachelors on the dive.
GTA Wiki lists Dobbs and Jeremy as friends on Jeremy's bachelor party.
